description: This is a Java test class 'GlobalEventRegistryTestCases' used for testing the registration and annotation of event classes related to the 'JsonParsableEvent' annotation. It contains test cases to ensure classes are correctly annotated, present in the classpath, and contain necessary methods for JSON parsing.

classes.name: GlobalEventRegistryTestCases
classes.description: An abstract test class designed to verify the registration, annotation, and classpath inclusion of event classes annotated with @JsonParsableEvent. It includes setup and multiple test methods for validation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the jsonParsableEvents list with classes annotated with @JsonParsableEvent, excluding the class named 'TestEvent'.

methods.name: sampleCheckForEventFromEachModule
methods.description: Verifies that the classpath contains at least one class from each module, ensuring all necessary event classes are present.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: Confirms that the set of sample classes covers all packages containing @JsonParsableEvent annotated classes.

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method that extracts distinct package sets from given classes.

methods.name: allEventsRegistered
methods.description: Checks that all subclasses of Event are annotated with @JsonParsableEvent.

methods.name: allRegisteredEventsContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: Ensures each @JsonParsableEvent annotated class has a method with the name specified in its annotation that accepts JsonObject and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Verifies that the class has the correct method for JSON parsing as specified by its @JsonParsableEvent annotation.

methods.name: getEventSubclasses
methods.description: Retrieves all non-abstract, non-interface subclasses of the Event class from the class index.
